notes.title: Sequel to the original escape room game hits Steam plus giveaway for limited edition T-shirts and other prizes
notes.content:
That gum you like is going to come back in… nope, wait, that’s the Red Room, we’re here to talk about the Crimson Room.

That’s a name you might remember if you spent any time hanging around on Newgrounds or Ebaum’s World back in the early 2000s because it was one of the most played flash games of all time, with a record setting 800M views. And now the creator of that original game, along with Dream Holdings, is back with Crimson Room Decade, a sequel taking place ten years after the events of the first game. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238589/b1e437ddd354dffa4ce2b6d2cf78949a71f30b90.jpg[/img]

The setup might look familiar but nothing is as you remembered it. All new puzzles will challenge your resolve. Explore the room in 3D space (and even in VR, which will be added in a future free update) and piece together the tragic backstory while you work towards your escape. Will you unlock all the mysteries of the Crimson Room?

The game is available now on Steam for $8.49 (15% launch discount)!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238589/16b6fa90f9f7fd86eee97f56434f7476e7e6e30c.jpg[/img]
 
We’re also hosting a giveaway all through launch week! Enter for a chance to win a limited edition Crimson Room Decade T-shirt (pictured above) and free games. 

[url=http://steam.degica.com/crimson-room#giveaway]Click here to enter![/url]
